entries.name: Translation Helps
entries.description: Door43 translation helps: Scripture, translation notes, translation words, and translation questions.
entries.purpose: Agents that need unfoldingWord's translation helps for a passage, as BT Servant does.

entries.name: Open Bible Stories and Five Movements
entries.description: Open Bible Stories and the Five Movements.
entries.purpose: Agents that need Open Bible Stories content and the Five Movements framework.

entries.name: Aquifer (community server)
entries.description: Bible study resources from the Aquifer: dictionaries, study notes, and lexicons, served by a community-built MCP server.
entries.purpose: Agents that need Aquifer study resources. This is the server BT Servant uses today; it holds the /s/aquifer shorthand (ADR 0004).

entries.name: Aquifer (official server)
entries.description: Bible study resources from the Aquifer: dictionaries, study notes, translation guides, and lexicons, served by the Aquifer team's own MCP server, announced 2026-10-27.
entries.purpose: Agents that need Aquifer study resources from the team that produces them. Listed side by side with the community server (ADR 0004).

entries.name: Bible Passages (BPd)
entries.description: Open Bible Stories and every passage in the Bible, organized by book and passage title, with the chapter and verse range as secondary information.
entries.purpose: The template library in translationCore Mobile v2, starting with the top 10 Strategic Languages, and finding a place in the story without book, chapter, and verse.

entries.name: Strategic Languages
entries.description: The list of Strategic Languages and its data.
entries.purpose: A permanent, official home for the list, which the Bible Passages dataset and other work depend on.

entries.name: Language and Bible publishing data
entries.description: Language data from Glottolog, the public Ethnologue, and the Registry of Language Variants, with available Bible publishing data.
entries.purpose: Tools like BT Servant answering questions about a language, such as which languages are spoken in a place and what has been published in them.

entries.name: Read-n-Grow picture Bible
entries.description: About 2,000 Read-n-Grow picture Bible images, about 600 of them used in Open Bible Stories, tagged with the passage each illustrates and the elements shown.
entries.purpose: Tools that need the right image for a passage.

entries.name: Bibles
entries.description: Open-licensed Bible texts in many languages.
entries.purpose: Translation workflows that need the real Scripture text for a verse in the target language instead of a fresh translation of the English.
